facts.fact: L'Union reports the 196 km Fougamou-Mouila section (Ngounie province), built and pre-financed by Moov Africa Gabon Telecom, now connects Fougamou and Mouila to the national backbone; it is the first segment of phase 1 of the extension, ceded to the State by a convention signed at Mouila (dated 'yesterday' in a 7 Oct 2026 article).
